record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only loss aggregation: average the existing BPR plus 0.2 pointwise loss over valid positions separately for each sampled user, then average those user losses across the batch. This gives short and long histories equal total weight, potentially improving user-averaged HR@10. Preserve the loss terms, features, embeddings, GRU, readout, scoring, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.
